_format: Shared golden for the queued-input reducer (Rust crates/engram-dashboard-agent/src/queued_input.rs and the TS accumulator). events = wire op objects fed in order (seq = index + 1). expect.items = open rows exactly, in order; expect.tombstones = id -> resurrectable, each must match; expect.tombstone_count = exact; expect.absent = ids that are neither row nor tombstone; expect.ack_unavailable = the verdict mark; expect.outcomes = id -> every verdict the reducer returned for that id, in order (Delivered | Cancelled | Discarded:<cause>), listed ids only.

cases.name: queued lists the item
items keep arrival order when one leaves
a second Queued of the same id is a no-op
a second Queued of a cancelling id is a no-op
queued then delivered
queued then withdrawn is cancelled
queued then dropped keeps the cause
answers without a request leave the item queued
cancel request moves the item to cancelling
a second cancel request is a no-op
cancelling then interrupted, agent ended or rejected is discarded
cancelling then withdrawn is cancelled
cancelling then delivered is delivered (too late)
not removed then delivered is delivered
vendor close before our answer waits in cancelling
a second vendor close changes nothing
vendor closed then delivered is delivered
attribution: vendor close then removed is cancelled
attribution: removed without a lifecycle line is cancelled at once; late lines are ignored
attribution: vendor close then not removed is discarded unknown
attribution: vendor close then cancel failure is discarded unknown
attribution: not removed then vendor close is discarded unknown
cancel failure keeps the item cancelling
cancel failure then delivered is delivered
cancel failure then vendor close is discarded unknown
cancel failure then ack unavailable is delivered
terminal events of unknown ids leave only tombstones
other events of unknown ids are dropped
dropped then queued of the same id stays off the list
sealed rewrite: synthesized end and a late queued rewritten as agent ended
an idle input rejected leaves a tombstone and the list unchanged
double delivered (codex started + completed) is one tombstone
resurrectable tombstone takes a late delivered once
queued, dropped unknown, delivered is revived
a non-resurrectable tombstone ignores delivered
rejected after delivered rereads the tombstone
rejected clears the resurrectable mark
an unknown closed by our not-removed answer is revived by delivered
other drops on a tombstone are ignored
ack unavailable delivers every queued item
ack unavailable with an unknown id leaves its tombstone
core rewrite after the verdict: queued plus ack unavailable of that one copy
after the verdict a raw queued still lists (the reducer never reads the mark; the core rewrites it)
ack unavailable closes cancelling items without waiting for the answer
late cancel answers after the verdict are ignored
codex handed-over cancel then echo is delivered
codex handed-over cancel then withdrawn is cancelled
codex handed-over cancel, unknown, late echo is revived
tombstone cap: 1024 + 1 evicts the oldest; a repeated tombstone keeps its place
